cautions: Group fields include order discount combination and item event name. Order/check aggregates across rows cannot be added as unique orders or uses. Frequency here means distinct accounting days with a reported event name.

Gross/net sum exactly matches separately collected canonical monthly control. Raw DiscountSum differs from gross-net in August and September and must not be renamed net discount burden or assigned to customer campaigns without surcharge reconciliation.
No customer IDs, order IDs, guest cards or employee identifiers collected.
NOT_DELETED filters match the canonical preset; returns are not independently excluded.
Event iikoCard and event Скидка iikoCard are distinct names and IDs.
An OLAP discount type is not a complete client promotion; bundles/fixed promotional prices/free components can exist without a named discount type.
No observed event in a month does not prove configuration inactive; no October extraction was requested for this limited inventory.

boundaries: Configuration is not proof of client eligibility, Starter publication or actual execution. Historical observed types are not the set of currently active offers.
Original action/condition order and settings strings preserved; settingsDecoded is an added parse, not rewritten original data.
No Starter promotion IDs are inferred from iiko names. Payment compatibility is not universal promotion compatibility.
Unknown numeric enums and empty scope lists remain unresolved. All coupon-series names are not available; category labels are captured separately.
Source filenames are provenance identifiers, not required runtime dependencies. Record embeds all available configuration and historical inventory; raw OLAP rows intentionally omitted.
